senses.sense_definition: De bereidheid om vergeving te schenken, medelijden te tonen of hulp te bieden aan mensen in nood.

examples.text: De rechter toonde <w>barmhartigheid</w> en gaf de jonge dader een lichtere straf.

target_lang_translations.en: The judge showed <w>mercy</w> and gave the young offender a lighter sentence.

examples.text: Zij pleitten voor <w>barmhartigheid</w> en vroegen om de vrijlating van de gevangenen.

target_lang_translations.en: They pleaded for <w>clemency</w> and asked for the release of the prisoners.

target_lang_definitions.en: The willingness to grant forgiveness, show compassion, or offer help to people in need.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: forgiveness or leniency shown to someone in one's power
sympathetic pity and concern for the sufferings or misfortunes of others
mercy or leniency, especially by a judge or ruler

senses.sense_definition: Liefdadigheid of het verlenen van materiële of morele hulp aan behoeftigen.

examples.text: De opvang van daklozen is een daad van pure <w>barmhartigheid</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: Sheltering the homeless is an act of pure <w>charity</w>.

examples.text: Zij zetten zich in voor werken van <w>barmhartigheid</w> binnen de gemeenschap.

target_lang_translations.en: They dedicated themselves to works of <w>mercy</w> within the community.

target_lang_definitions.en: Charity or the provision of material or moral assistance to those in need.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: voluntary giving of help, typically money or food, to those in need
the practice of giving money or food to poor people

examples.text: Zijn <w>barmhartigheid</w> was helaas erg laag, waardoor hij weinig begrip toonde.

target_lang_translations.en: His <w>mercifulness</w> was unfortunately very low, which is why he showed little understanding.

examples.text: De non kon met haar grote <w>barmhartigheid</w> troost schenken aan de gevallen ziel.

target_lang_translations.en: The nun, with her great <w>compassion</w>, was able to bring comfort to the fallen soul.

target_lang_definitions.en: The degree to which someone is merciful or compassionate.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: the quality of being merciful and compassionate
the quality of showing sympathy and concern for others
